cases.name: migrations rerun safely without resetting existing profiles
order detail contains original items and contact; search by phone/email works
unassigned requests and details inaccessible to sales and dealers
manager assigns request; only assigned sales gains access
stale edits fail without changing status
sales cannot reassign or inject payment fields; accountant cannot write
invalid dealer assignee rolls back entire order change
rejection needs reason, reopening terminal request requires manager
unsupported state jumps rejected; READY stays unpaid and creates no stock/debt
notes persist and reject cross-dealer or unassigned partner access
create due task with scoped owner and complete it with conflict control
task assignee must be allowed to read the linked customer
UI assignments enforce role and scope; invalid batch preserves old grants
removing request assignment also hides its notes and tasks from previous sales
extended customer profile and contact search persist
duplicate suggestions only include records user can access
catalog unit and SKU changes preserve public ID and website price
report counts actual requests and labels value separately from revenue
admin session revoke, role validation and role change clear assignments
password reset and self password change revoke all existing sessions
date validation and pagination keep complete request history accessible
